groups:
  - name: raion-slo-payment-api-availability
    interval: 30s
    rules:
      - record: raion_slo:bad:rate5m
        expr: sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="payment-api",http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) or vector(0)
        labels:
          service_name: payment-api
          slo: availability
          slo_window: 30d
      - record: raion_slo:total:rate5m
        expr: sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="payment-api"}[5m]))
        labels:
          service_name: payment-api
          slo: availability
          slo_window: 30d
      - record: raion_slo:error_ratio:rate5m
        expr: sum_over_time(raion_slo:bad:rate5m{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"}[5m]) / sum_over_time(raion_slo:total:rate5m{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"}[5m])
        labels:
          service_name: payment-api
          slo: availability
          slo_window: 30d
      - record: raion_slo:error_ratio:rate30m
        expr: sum_over_time(raion_slo:bad:rate5m{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"}[30m]) / sum_over_time(raion_slo:total:rate5m{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"}[30m])
        labels:
          service_name: payment-api
          slo: availability
          slo_window: 30d
      - record: raion_slo:error_ratio:rate1h
        expr: sum_over_time(raion_slo:bad:rate5m{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"}[1h]) / sum_over_time(raion_slo:total:rate5m{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"}[1h])
        labels:
          service_name: payment-api
          slo: availability

        labels:
          service_name: payment-api
          slo: availability

      - record: raion_slo:error_ratio:rate6h
        expr: sum_over_time(raion_slo:bad:rate5m{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"}[6h]) / sum_over_time(raion_slo:total:rate5m{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"}[6h])
        labels:
          service_name: payment-api
          slo: availability
          slo_window: 30d
      - record: raion_slo:error_ratio:rate1d
        expr: sum_over_time(raion_slo:bad:rate5m{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"}[1d]) / sum_over_time(raion_slo:total:rate5m{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"}[1d])
        labels:
          service_name: payment-api
          slo: availability
          slo_window: 30d
      - record: raion_slo:error_ratio:rate3d
        expr: sum_over_time(raion_slo:bad:rate5m{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"}[3d]) / sum_over_time(raion_slo:total:rate5m{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"}[3d])

      - record: raion_slo:error_ratio:window
        expr: sum_over_time(raion_slo:bad:rate5m{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"}[30d]) / sum_over_time(raion_slo:total:rate5m{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"}[30d])
        labels:
          service_name: payment-api
          slo: availability
          slo_window: 30d
      - record: raion_slo:sli:ratio
        expr: 1 - raion_slo:error_ratio:window{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"}
        labels:
          service_name: payment-api
          slo: availability
          slo_window: 30d
      - record: raion_slo:objective:ratio
        expr: vector(0.999)
        labels:
          service_name: payment-api
          slo: availability
          slo_window: 30d
      - record: raion_slo:error_budget_remaining:ratio
        expr: 1 - raion_slo:error_ratio:window{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"} / 0.001
        labels:
          service_name: payment-api
          slo: availability
          slo_window: 30d
      - alert: SLOErrorBudgetBurnFast
        expr: (raion_slo:error_ratio:rate1h{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"} > 0.0144 and raion_slo:error_ratio:rate5m{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"} > 0.0144) or (raion_slo:error_ratio:rate6h{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"} > 0.006 and raion_slo:error_ratio:rate30m{service_name="payment-api",slo="availability"} > 0.006)
        for: 2m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          service_name: payment-api
          slo: availability
          team: payments
          raion_scope: slo
        annotations:
          summary: 'payment-api: the "availability" SLO is using its error budget fast'
          description: "payment-api is failing its 99.9% objective (requests that did not fail with a server error) at 14.4× or more the sustainable rate: at this pace the 30d error budget is gone in about 2 days. Act now."

        for: 15m

          slo: availability

        annotations:

          description: payment-api has been using its 30d error budget faster than it can afford for hours (requests that did not fail with a server error, objective 99.9%). Not urgent, but plan a fix before the budget runs out.
          dashboard_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/grafana/d/raion-slos
          service_dashboard_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/grafana/d/raion-svc-payment-api
          raion_url: http://127.0.0.1:7600/services/payment-api
          runbook_url: https://wiki.example.com/runbooks/payment-api-availability
